categories.main_business_segments: Hanwha Investment & Securities operates primarily in financial investment services including investment trading, brokerage, advisory, discretionary investment, trust services, and related ancillary businesses. The company’s operations are divided into WM (Wealth Management), Wholesale, Trading, and Investment Banking (IB) segments, with additional focus on digital financial services through subsidiaries in Southeast Asia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced financial technologies such as digital trading platforms (WTS/MTS), social trading apps, and AI-based portfolio management tools. It also utilizes risk management systems, automated trading systems, and digital asset management platforms to support its brokerage, trading, and asset management services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanwha Investment & Securities serves individual retail investors, institutional clients, corporations, and professional investors. Its markets include domestic Korean financial markets and growing digital financial markets in Southeast Asia, particularly Vietnam and Singapore, targeting both retail and institutional investors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with 40 domestic branches and extends its presence internationally through subsidiaries in Vietnam (Pinetree Securities Corporation) and Singapore (Pinetree Securities Pte. Ltd.), focusing on Southeast Asian digital financial markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanwha Investment & Securities operates as a midstream financial intermediary in the capital markets supply chain, providing brokerage, asset management, investment advisory, and underwriting services. It also engages in proprietary trading and investment banking activities, positioning itself between capital providers and capital users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding digital financial services, particularly in Southeast Asia, enhancing digital asset management platforms, and investing in fintech partnerships. It focuses on innovation in digital brokerage, social trading, and new financial product development, alongside strengthening risk management and compliance frameworks.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through brokerage commissions, asset management fees, trading profits, underwriting and advisory fees, trust management fees, and interest income from credit extensions. The company also earns management and performance fees from venture capital and private equity investments, as well as income from digital financial services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanwha Investment & Securities competes with major domestic securities firms and foreign financial institutions operating in Korea and Southeast Asia. It holds a competitive position with strengths in bond trading, digital brokerage, and asset management, while expanding its footprint in emerging digital markets to differentiate from traditional competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated total assets of approximately KRW 13.25 trillion and equity of KRW 1.57 trillion, with a net profit turnaround to KRW 93 billion. It has shown steady asset growth (~9.4% year-over-year) and is investing in growth through digital expansion and Southeast Asian market entry, reflecting a positive growth trajectory despite market volatility.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanwha Investment & Securities emphasizes comprehensive one-stop financial services integrating brokerage, asset management, and investment banking with advanced digital platforms. Its competitive differentiation lies in its strong bond market expertise, innovative digital financial products, strategic Southeast Asian expansion, and robust risk management capabilities.
